blocks.text: Computer Management → Network & Remote provides Connection Profiles and network status tools. NetworkManager manages the profile-controlled Ethernet/Wi-Fi policy. Prefer these tools to editing routes or restarting networking by hand.

nmcli -t -f STATE general
nmcli -f DEVICE,TYPE,STATE device status
These commands show local state only. Do not publish connection names, MAC addresses, addresses or routes without review. A connected link does not prove DNS or remote-service access.

Managed files live under /etc/NetworkManager/. Connection secrets require protected storage and administrator authority. If connectivity fails, follow [Network troubleshooting](help:troubleshooting.network) before changing interfaces or firewall rules.
